message: The [{1}] contract on '{0}' is redundant because a fabric automatically adds the [NotNull] contract to this declaration.
rationale: The message does not name the declaration although the report sites in ContractExtensions.VerifyNotNullableDeclarations pass it as {0}, so the user cannot tell which of several redundant contracts is meant in a list of warnings.
codeChange: The report sites pass nameof(NotNullAttribute) and nameof(RequiredAttribute) as {1}, so the message shows '[NotNullAttribute]' and '[RequiredAttribute]', while the sibling LAMA5001 and LAMA5002 messages show the short aspect name ('[NotNull]'). Consider passing "NotNull" and "Required" for consistency.
